subject: Re: Saturday appointment slot
text: Your proposed two-hour slot works for the venue, but the committee has changed priorities after last night's call. Because we must finalize the stage schedule first, the appointment cannot focus on decorations anymore. Please move the discussion to timing, speaker order, and the sound check. If anyone still wants decorative updates, bring one slide or a single photo, and we will handle it only if time remains. I will arrive at seven to open the hall, so plan to begin by seven fifteen and finish by nine thirty at the latest. Send any agenda additions before four o'clock today, not after the meeting, because I need one printed copy. If a person cannot come, reply here rather than waiting until the appointment, so we can reserve the room for someone else. Bring your own charger, since the outlet near the door is missing. Do not spend time on banner colors until we agree on the stage layout. The earlier assumption about a full cleanup crew is no longer accurate; we are short three volunteers, so ask each attendee to plan fifteen minutes for packing. If those adjustments are impossible, suggest one shorter alternative within the next two days. Otherwise, confirm the revised focus by tonight.
